proofs.text: Write a person's approval for `RULE-1`, then run the auto-approval; verify nothing is written

reasons: PROOF-20 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: CI leaves a rule that already carries a current approval alone rather than writing a second one

tests.body:
def test_a_rule_already_approved_is_left_alone(self, proved):
        entry = proved.rule('RULE-1')
        approve_module.write_approval(
            proved.root, 'login', 'RULE-1', 'jane@acme.com', None, None,
            'tested', 'low', entry=entry)
        assert approve_module.auto_approve(proved.root) == []
